name: Hospitality
overview: Scripture reveals hospitality as a gracious and tangible expression of care and respect towards others, exemplified by Abraham’s readiness to serve and comfort his guests with water, bread, and rest. The account of Melchizedek offering bread and wine further underscores hospitality’s sacred dimension, linking it to God’s priestly blessing. These passages demonstrate that true hospitality involves both practical provision and heartfelt welcome, reflecting a servant’s heart that honors and cherishes those who come in need or as strangers.
